Name: Multiple Farms For Multiplayer
Author: LyzzCL
Description:
[size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/PbTNDnG.png[/img]
Adds multiple farms around the valley (7), each farm is taken from the vanilla farms with minimal changes to keep consistency with how you access them and how they are integrated in the world, this is to achieve an immersive experience if you want to play in multiplayer and have each player their own farm.

You don't need to play in multiplayer, this is 100% functional on single player if you just want more land to build. It is designed with multiple people in mind but you can disable every aspect of multiplayer on the config.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qLNYGDt.png[/img][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]FTM[/url] for basic functionality and patches.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿ to edit your farms or enable/disable them and selecting if you want starter items, cabins or buildings before creating a new save.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4715]Reset Terrain Features[/url] if you are updating the mod or adding/switching farms in an existing save.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Vi3uJBS.png[/img][/size]

[list=1]
[*][size=3]To install drag the folder inside the .zip to the Mods folder of your game.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Check the config with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿ before making a world to enable/disable your desired starter stuff.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Tell your friends to join the world. Just like vanilla worlds, it won't let you know which Cabin is which so you would need to organize with your friends to join 1 by 1, cabins should be loaded in this order: Wilderness, Forest, Beach, Riverland, Meadowlands, Hilltop and Four Corners. Though if you wan't to make sure every player has their own cabin in their desired farm disable the Starter Cabins option and build them from Robin 1 by 1 while your friends join.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/wOoWJWQ.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]7 farms from base game are included:
- Wilderness, Forest, Beach, Riverland, Meadowlands, Hilltop and Four Corners.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Each farm has their respective vanilla perks and fishes:
- Wilderness: spawns monsters at night.
- Forest: spawns forage each day.
- Beach: spawns unique beach forage and supply crates.
- Meadowlands: has starter blue grass.
- Hilltop: dedicated quarry space.
- Four Corners: nothing special but might be the one with the most space as I removed divider cliffs.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Optional starter crates with items for each farm. [color=#b6b6b6][[/color][color=#93c47d]True[/color][color=#b6b6b6] by default][/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Optional starter cabins on each farm. [color=#b6b6b6][[/color][color=#93c47d]True[/color][color=#b6b6b6] by default][/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Optional starter buildings: [color=#b6b6b6][[/color][color=#93c47d]True[/color][color=#b6b6b6] by default][/color]
- Wilderness: Slime Hutch.
- Meadowlands: Coop with 2 chickens.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Toggle to enable or disable each farm [color=#e69138](Must be done before creating a new save)[/color].[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Configurable names for each farm, useful for Robin build menu [color=#e69138](Name change will reflect on save reload)[/color].[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Support for custom farms for Advanced users, might require basic knowdledge of CP and Tiled.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/efPYA1X.png[/img]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿ — [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] — [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url] — [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6626]Lunna Astray[/url] — [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12208]Fishing Pond Facilities[/url] — [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24852]Coal Point Farm[/url] — [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30295]Pelican Valley Loft[/url] — [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30888]Baldur's Village[/url] — [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44095]Gem Sea Shores[/url] — [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url]﻿

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WqC0Bu1.png[/img][/size]
